description: Private IEEE 802.15.4 low level L2 helper utilities for internal use in the network stack, including functions for sending fragments, channel access, acknowledgment handling, and waiting for ACKs.

methods.name: ieee802154_radio_send
methods.description: Sends a fragment respecting IEEE 802.15.4 access arbitration and retransmission protocols.

methods.name: ieee802154_wait_for_clear_channel
methods.description: Implements channel access algorithm to determine if the radio channel is clear to send.

methods.name: ieee802154_prepare_for_ack
methods.description: Prepares acknowledgment reception on the TX path if the packet requires acknowledgment.

methods.name: ieee802154_wait_for_ack
methods.description: Waits for ACK reception with standard timeout settings after transmission.
